answer_2.quote: For non-LLM based methods, we report BLEU and ROUGE-L as representative n-gram based metrics, as well as BERTScore for embedding-based metric.

answer_3.quote: Frameworks such as RAGAS and RAG-Checker have demonstrated that LLMs can provide scalable and automated assessments of metrics such as context relevance and faithfulness.

answer_4.quote: Two human annotators then judge which answer is more faithful to the source, reaching 95% agreement.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators assign preference labels (significantly better, slightly better, tie, slightly worse, significantly worse).
